outcome.shown: In Verona, Romeo Montague and Juliet Capulet fall deeply in love despite their families' long-standing and violent feud. After a secret marriage performed by Friar Laurence, their happiness is shattered when Romeo is banished for killing Juliet’s cousin, Tybalt, in a retaliatory duel. To escape an arranged marriage to another man, Juliet fakes her own death with a sleeping potion, but a misunderstanding leads Romeo to believe she is truly dead. Consumed by grief, he takes his own life at her tomb, and upon waking to find him dead, Juliet kills herself as well. Their tragic end ultimately forces their grieving families to reconcile and end their bitter conflict.
